title: Mythicores
description: This project adds new ores , blocks and tools to minecraft world
body:
# 🔥 Mythic Ores Expansion 🔥

### Forge 1.20.1 Survival Content Expansion Mod for Minecraft

Deep beneath the Nether lava seas… hidden within forgotten mountain caverns… and scattered across the endless void of the End… ancient minerals have awakened once again.

**Mythic Ores Expansion** transforms your Minecraft survival world into a dangerous fantasy adventure by introducing powerful new ores, legendary equipment, and progression-focused gameplay designed for explorers, warriors, miners, and endgame players.

This mod is built for players who want Minecraft to feel more rewarding, more dangerous, and far more immersive while still keeping the classic vanilla survival experience intact.

---

# ⚔️ Three Legendary Ores

The mod introduces three unique ore systems, each designed around a completely different playstyle and progression path.

Every ore includes:

* Custom world generation
* Full armor set
* Complete tool set
* Special effects
* Vanilla-style crafting
* Survival balancing
* Creative inventory support
* Minecraft-style textures

Unlike simple “stronger diamond” mods, every material in Mythic Ores Expansion has its own identity, strengths, weaknesses, and purpose.

---

# 🩸 Bloodstone Ore — Power of the Nether

## “The stone forged in burning hatred.”

Hidden deep inside the Nether lies the terrifying **Bloodstone Ore**, a glowing crimson mineral infused with unstable heat and ancient rage.

Bloodstone appears near lava oceans and dangerous Nether regions, rewarding brave players willing to risk everything in hostile environments.

### 🔥 Bloodstone Features

* Nether-exclusive ore generation
* Dark glowing red appearance
* Medium rarity
* Emits low red light
* Fire-themed combat bonuses
* Aggressive weapon design

---

## ⚔ Bloodstone Equipment

Bloodstone equipment focuses entirely on offensive gameplay.

### Bloodstone Weapons

Weapons forged from Bloodstone are brutal and fast:

* High attack damage
* Faster swing speed
* Fiery visual appearance
* Sword ignites enemies briefly

### Bloodstone Armor

Bloodstone armor provides:

* High durability
* Strong protection
* Fire resistance bonuses when wearing the full set

Perfect for:

* Nether exploration
* PvE combat
* Boss battles
* Hardcore survival worlds

Bloodstone equipment feels powerful, dangerous, and intimidating — exactly like the Nether itself.

---

# ❄ Mithril Ore — Ancient Silver of the Mountains

## “Light as wind. Sharp as ice.”

Mithril is an ancient magical metal found in deep mountain caves and underground crystal-rich regions.

Unlike Bloodstone, Mithril focuses on elegance, speed, efficiency, and enchantments.

Its silver-blue glow and polished fantasy-inspired appearance make it one of the most visually refined materials in the mod.

---

## ⛏ Mithril Features

* Overworld generation
* Rare mountain ore
* Silver-blue magical appearance
* High enchantability
* Lightweight tool design
* Faster movement bonuses

---

## ⚡ Mithril Equipment

Mithril gear is designed for players who prefer speed and mobility over raw power.

### Mithril Tools

Mithril tools:

* Mine faster
* Swing quicker
* Feel lightweight
* Have excellent enchantability

### Mithril Armor

Wearing Mithril armor grants:

* Increased movement speed
* Smooth mobility
* Strong durability without excessive heaviness

Perfect for:

* Exploration
* Mining
* Fast-paced survival gameplay
* Enchantment builds

Mithril bridges the gap between utility and strength while staying balanced within vanilla progression.

---

# 🌌 Voidshard Ore — Relic of the End

## “The Void remembers everything.”

Far beyond the main End island, hidden among the outer islands and floating structures, lies the rarest material in the mod:
**Voidshard Ore**.

Voidshard is infused with unstable void energy and cosmic power from the End dimension itself.

It represents the final stage of progression in Mythic Ores Expansion.

---

## 🟣 Voidshard Features

* End-exclusive generation
* Extremely rare
* Purple-black crystal appearance
* Emits void-like particles
* Endgame-tier material
* Cosmic visual design

---

## 🗡 Voidshard Equipment

Voidshard equipment combines durability, utility, and dimensional power.

### Voidshard Weapons

Voidshard weapons:

* Deal massive damage
* Possess end-themed effects
* Can slightly teleport enemies on hit

### Voidshard Armor

Voidshard armor provides:

* Reduced fall damage
* Excellent durability
* End exploration utility

### Voidshard Tools

Tools gain:

* Faster mining speed inside the End
* Strong late-game performance

Perfect for:

* Endgame survival
* Dragon fights
* Long-term worlds
* Exploration-based gameplay

Voidshard gear feels ancient, mysterious, and unbelievably powerful without completely replacing Netherite.

---

# 🏗 Balanced Survival Progression

The mod is carefully balanced to preserve Minecraft’s survival experience.

### Progression System

```text
Iron < Mithril < Diamond < Voidshard ≈ Netherite
```

Each material serves a purpose:

* Bloodstone = combat
* Mithril = speed & utility
* Voidshard = endgame power

This creates meaningful equipment choices instead of one material replacing everything else.

---

# 🎨 Vanilla-Friendly Style

Mythic Ores Expansion is designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft.

The mod includes:

* 16x16-style textures
* Vanilla-inspired crafting
* Familiar progression systems
* Creative tab integration
* Balanced stats
* Consistent item design

Everything fits naturally into Minecraft survival gameplay.

---

# 🧱 Included Content

## 🪨 Blocks

* Bloodstone Ore
* Mithril Ore
* Voidshard Ore

## 💎 Materials

* Bloodstone Gem
* Mithril Ingot
* Voidshard Crystal

## ⚔ Weapons

* Sword
* Axe

## ⛏ Tools

* Pickaxe
* Shovel
* Hoe

## 🛡 Armor Sets

* Helmet
* Chestplate
* Leggings
* Boots

---

# 🌍 World Generation

The world feels more rewarding and dangerous thanks to carefully designed ore spawning systems.

### Nether

Bloodstone generates:

* Near lava
* In dangerous regions
* Medium rarity

### Overworld

Mithril generates:

* Mountains
* Deep caves
* Rare underground clusters

### End

Voidshard generates:

* Outer End islands
* High-risk exploration areas
* Extremely rare deposits

Exploration becomes meaningful again.

---

Forge

## ✅ Features

* Proper loot tables
* Survival crafting recipes
* Creative inventory support
* Localization support
* Stable Gradle setup
* Multiplayer compatible
* Vanilla-friendly balancing

---

# 💀 Designed For Players Who Love:

* RPG progression
* Fantasy survival
* Exploration
* Dangerous dimensions
* Powerful weapons
* Endgame content
* Vanilla+ gameplay
* Long survival worlds

---

# 🔥 Mythic Ores Expansion Changes Minecraft Into:

* A fantasy survival adventure
* A dangerous exploration experience
* A deeper progression system
* A world worth mining again

Forge your destiny.
Master the Nether.
Harness ancient silver.
Control the power of the Void.
